o: A farmer is driving a tractor.

o: Some luggage has been placed by a door.
A man is carrying a suitcase.
Suitcases are being loaded into a car.
p1.why: Hành lý đã được đặt cạnh cửa (has been placed). Tranh không có người nên "is carrying", "are being loaded", "is being watered" đều sai.

o: A man is putting books on a shelf.
A man is writing in a notebook.
A man is reading a book.
A man is closing a window.
p1.why: Người đàn ông đang đọc sách. Anh không xếp sách lên kệ (kệ ở xa), không viết, không đóng cửa sổ.

o: A man is diving into a pool.
A man is swimming in a pool.
p1.why: Người đàn ông đang bơi trong hồ. Anh không nhảy xuống, không ai đang dọn hồ hay gấp ghế.

o: People are swimming in the ocean.
A boat is being pulled onto the sand.
Some umbrellas have been set up on the beach.
p1.why: Ô che nắng đã được dựng trên bãi biển (have been set up). Không có người bơi, không có thuyền, không ai đang chồng ghế.

p5.s: The committee found the proposal highly -------, so it approved the budget right away.
p5.why: find + tân ngữ + (highly) + tính từ: found the proposal highly persuasive.

p5.s: The updated price list ------- to all distributors next Monday.
p5.why: Bảng giá được gửi (bị động) vào thứ Hai tới (next Monday) → tương lai bị động: will be sent.

p5.s: The new software allows users to share files ------- with colleagues in other offices.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ share cần trạng từ: easily.

p5.s: Visitors are not allowed to take photographs ------- the exhibition halls.
p5.why: inside + nơi chốn = bên trong các phòng trưng bày → inside.

p5.s: By the time the new manager arrived, the team ------- most of the annual report.
p5.why: By the time + quá khứ đơn (arrived) → việc xong trước đó: quá khứ hoàn thành had completed.

p5.s: The marketing team is responsible for the ------- of the new product line.
p5.why: Sau the và trước of cần danh từ: promotion.

p5.s: Please send your application ------- the human resources department.
p5.why: send something to + nơi nhận → to.

p5.s: If the shipment ------- late again, we will look for a new supplier.
p5.why: Câu điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn (arrives), will + V.

p5.s: The new smartphone will be ------- available in stores next month.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ available cần trạng từ: widely available (bán rộng rãi).

p5.s: Mr. Hughes and ------- team will present the quarterly results on Friday.
p5.why: Trước danh từ team cần tính từ sở hữu: his.

p5.s: Applicants should have ------- experience in project management.
p5.why: Trước danh từ experience cần tính từ: considerable (đáng kể).

p5.s: The staff lounge is located ------- the copy room and the kitchen.
p5.why: between A and B = ở giữa hai nơi → between. among dùng cho từ ba người / vật trở lên.

p5.s: ------- applicant will receive an e-mail confirming the interview time.
p5.why: applicant số ít, động từ will receive → Each. All, Both, Several cần danh từ số nhiều.

p5.s: The board of directors is considering ------- a second factory in the region.
p5.why: consider + V-ing → opening.

p5.s: Employees may leave early on Friday ------- they have finished their weekly reports.
p5.why: as long as = miễn là (điều kiện). so that chỉ mục đích, even though là mặc dù, as if là như thể.

p5.s: Ms. Novak prepared the presentation slides ------- because her assistant was on vacation.
p5.why: Tự mình làm (không có trợ lý) → đại từ phản thân nhấn mạnh: herself.

p5.s: Requests to work from home must be submitted ------- writing.
p5.why: in writing = bằng văn bản (cụm cố định) → in.

p5.s: The new printer uses ------- ink than the old one, so it is cheaper to run.
p5.why: ink không đếm được, có than → so sánh hơn: less. fewer, few đi với danh từ đếm được.

p5.s: Ms. Grant asked that all expense reports ------- by the end of the month.
p5.why: asked that + chủ ngữ + động từ nguyên mẫu; báo cáo được nộp (bị động) → be submitted.

p5.s: ------- the software is expensive, many small firms buy it because it saves them time.
p5.why: Hai vế trái chiều (đắt nhưng vẫn mua vì tiết kiệm thời gian) → Although.

p5.s: The Denver office reported strong results, but our sales were even higher than -------.
p5.why: So với doanh số của văn phòng Denver → đại từ sở hữu thay cho their sales: theirs.

p5.s: The company will ------- a new training program for all managers next month.
p5.why: launch a program = triển khai chương trình. arrive, belong, occur là nội động từ, không đi với tân ngữ.

p5.s: Customers can return items to any of our stores ------- by mail within thirty days.
p5.why: Hai cách lựa chọn (mang tới cửa hàng hoặc gửi qua bưu điện) → or.

p5.s: Please ------- the attached file for details about the conference schedule.
p5.why: consult a file = xem tài liệu để tra. refer cần to (refer to), inform và notify cần người làm tân ngữ.

p5.s: Not only did the new system reduce costs, ------- it also improved customer satisfaction.
p5.why: Cấu trúc Not only … but (also) → but.

p5.s: Passengers should ------- their seat belts before the plane takes off.
p5.why: fasten a seat belt = thắt dây an toàn → fasten. button, knot, tie không đi với seat belt.

p5.s: The proposal was ------- complicated that the committee asked for a simpler version.
p5.why: so + tính từ + that = đến nỗi → so. such cần danh từ, too đi với to V.

p5.s: The new parking rules will take ------- on September 1.
p5.why: take effect = bắt đầu có hiệu lực (quy định) → effect.

p5.s: Mr. Silva was ------- to regional sales director after five years with the firm.
p5.why: be promoted to a position = được thăng chức → promoted.

p5.s: The new manager has been working ------- to reduce delivery times.
p5.why: work hard = làm việc chăm chỉ (hard là trạng từ). hardly = hầu như không, sai nghĩa.

p6.title: To all residents of Maple Court
p6.text: Water service to the building {1} on Wednesday, June 14, from 9:00 A.M. to 1:00 P.M. while the city replaces a pipe on Oak Street. {2} We recommend filling a few bottles with water before the work begins. {3}, please avoid using washing machines and dishwashers for an hour after the service returns, as the water may be cloudy at first. We apologize for the {4} and thank you for your understanding. — Maple Court Management

gaps.why: Việc cắt nước diễn ra vào thứ Tư 14/6 (thông báo trước) → tương lai bị động: will be shut off.

o: Residents will not be able to use any taps during this time.
The city replaced the pipe on Oak Street last year.
Maple Court has a new swimming pool.
Washing machines are available in the basement.
gaps.a: Residents will not be able to use any taps during this time.
gaps.why: Vừa báo giờ cắt nước → câu chèn nói hệ quả (không dùng được vòi nước), rồi mới khuyên trữ nước. "The city replaced the pipe … last year" trái với việc đang thay ống.
Thêm một lời dặn nữa (không dùng máy giặt, máy rửa bát) → In addition.
apologize for the + danh từ: interruption (sự gián đoạn).

p6.title: To: Samir Haddad · From: Seaview Lodge · Subject: Your reservation
p6.text: Dear Mr. Haddad, Thank you for booking two nights at the Seaview Lodge. Your room {1} for check-in from 3:00 P.M. on July 2. Because you mentioned that you will arrive late, we have arranged for the night manager to give you your key at the front desk. {2} Breakfast is served in the garden café from 7:00 to 10:00 A.M. and is included in your rate. {3}, guests can borrow bicycles free of charge to explore the coastal path. If you need anything before your stay, please do not hesitate to {4} us. We look forward to welcoming you.

gaps.why: Ngày nhận phòng 2/7 ở tương lai → will be ready.

o: The front desk is staffed twenty-four hours a day.
The garden café is closed for renovations.
Bicycles must be returned by noon on July 1.
Please check in before noon so that we can prepare your room.
gaps.a: The front desk is staffed twenty-four hours a day.
gaps.why: Nối với ý khách đến muộn, nhận chìa khoá ở quầy → quầy có người trực cả ngày đêm. Ba câu kia trái với đoạn (quán vẫn phục vụ bữa sáng, khách chưa tới ngày 1/7, nhận phòng từ 15:00).
Thêm một tiện ích nữa (mượn xe đạp miễn phí) sau bữa sáng → Furthermore.
contact us = liên hệ với chúng tôi. reply, respond, communicate cần giới từ (reply to, respond to, communicate with).

p6.title: Fairbrook Transit Adds Late-Night Buses
p6.text: Beginning next month, Fairbrook Transit will run buses until midnight on weekdays, two hours later than it does now. Transit director Amina Yusuf said the change {1} by a survey of riders last spring. "Many people told us they had no way to get home after their evening shifts," she said. {2} The extra service will be paid for with a grant from the Hillcrest Foundation. The agency also plans to sell a discounted monthly pass for night workers. {3} the pass will save riders money, it will be sold only at the downtown ticket office. A full schedule of the new routes is {4} on the agency's Web site.

gaps.why: Cuộc khảo sát mùa xuân năm ngoái (last spring) dẫn tới thay đổi; thay đổi chịu tác động → quá khứ bị động: was prompted.

o: More than half of the riders surveyed said later buses would help them.
The survey was canceled because few people took part.
The agency has decided to end all evening service.
Buses will no longer stop at the downtown station.
gaps.a: More than half of the riders surveyed said later buses would help them.
gaps.why: Nối tiếp kết quả khảo sát (người đi làm ca tối không có xe về) → hơn nửa số người được hỏi nói xe buýt muộn sẽ giúp họ. Huỷ khảo sát, bỏ mọi chuyến buổi tối trái với đoạn; bỏ trạm trung tâm không nối với câu trước và trái với việc bán vé ở trung tâm.
Vé tháng giúp tiết kiệm nhưng chỉ bán ở một quầy → hai ý trái chiều: Although. Because / Since (vì) không hợp lý, Unless (trừ khi) sai nghĩa.
be + tính từ: is available (có sẵn).

p6.title: To: All Staff · From: IT Department · Subject: Password change
p6.text: All employees will be required to change their computer passwords by Friday, October 10. New passwords must contain at least twelve characters, including one number and one symbol. {1} Passwords that do not meet these requirements will be rejected automatically. To change your password, open the settings menu and choose Account Security {2} the list on the left. {3} you have any trouble, our help desk staff will be happy to assist you. Please remember that IT employees will never ask you to {4} your password by e-mail or phone.

o: The new password also cannot match any of your last five passwords.
Passwords no longer need to include a symbol.
The help desk moved to the second floor last year.
Employees may share their passwords with their managers.
gaps.a: The new password also cannot match any of your last five passwords.
gaps.why: Thêm một yêu cầu nữa cho mật khẩu mới (also), rồi tới câu "không đạt các yêu cầu này sẽ bị từ chối". Hai câu trái với đoạn (bỏ ký hiệu, chia sẻ mật khẩu).
choose something from a list = chọn từ danh sách → from.
Điều kiện: nếu gặp khó khăn thì bộ phận hỗ trợ giúp → If.
ask somebody to + động từ nguyên mẫu → to share.

docs.title: Text messages
docs.text:
Priya Shah (11:20 A.M.): Hi Jonas, are you still at the print shop?
Jonas Weber (11:21 A.M.): Just leaving. Why?
Priya Shah (11:22 A.M.): The client wants fifty more copies of the event program for tonight.
Jonas Weber (11:24 A.M.): They close at noon on Saturdays.
Priya Shah (11:25 A.M.): Could you go back in and ask them now? I'll send you the file again.
Jonas Weber (11:26 A.M.): Sure, I'm turning around.

qs.q: What does Ms. Shah want Mr. Weber to do?
qs.a: Ask the shop to print more programs
w: Pick up a client from the station
Cancel the event planned for tonight
Send her the event file again
qs.ev: The client wants fifty more copies of the event program for tonight.
qs.why: Khách cần thêm 50 bản chương trình; cô nhờ anh quay lại tiệm in hỏi in thêm. Chính cô sẽ gửi lại tệp cho anh, không phải ngược lại.

qs.q: At 11:24 A.M., what does Mr. Weber most likely mean when he writes, "They close at noon on Saturdays"?
qs.a: There is little time to place the order.
w: He cannot return to the shop today.
He wants to go back on Monday.
qs.ev: They close at noon on Saturdays.
qs.why: Tiệm đóng cửa lúc 12 giờ (lúc đó là 11:24) → còn rất ít thời gian; ngay sau đó anh quay lại tiệm.

docs.title: Notice · Elmwood Shopping Center
docs.text:
Escalators closed for inspection
The escalators in the north wing will be closed from Monday, March 3, to Wednesday, March 5, for their annual safety inspection. During this time, shoppers may reach the upper floors by using the two elevators next to the food court. All stores and restaurants will remain open as usual. We apologize for any inconvenience.

qs.q: Why will the escalators be closed?
w: The north wing is being made larger.
A special event will be held there.
qs.ev: for their annual safety inspection
qs.why: Thang cuốn đóng để kiểm tra an toàn hằng năm.

qs.q: What can shoppers do during the closure?
w: Shop only in the south wing
qs.ev: shoppers may reach the upper floors by using the two elevators next to the food court
qs.why: Khách lên tầng trên bằng 2 thang máy cạnh khu ẩm thực. Mọi cửa hàng vẫn mở nên "chỉ mua ở cánh nam" sai.

docs.title: Advertisement · Heel & Sole Express
docs.text:
Shoe Repair While You Wait
Broken heel? Worn-out soles? Heel & Sole Express can replace most heels in 20 minutes while you relax in our waiting area. Larger repairs, such as new soles, are ready the next business day. Drop off your shoes before 2:00 P.M. for next-day pickup at any of our five downtown locations. First-time customers save 20 percent with the code NEWSTEP.
Heel & Sole Express: fast, simple, affordable.

qs.q: What is being advertised?
qs.ev: Heel & Sole Express can replace most heels in 20 minutes
qs.why: Quảng cáo dịch vụ sửa giày (thay gót, thay đế), không phải cửa hàng bán giày.

qs.q: How can first-time customers get a discount?
w: By dropping off shoes before 2:00 P.M.
qs.ev: First-time customers save 20 percent with the code NEWSTEP.
qs.why: Khách lần đầu nhập mã NEWSTEP được giảm 20%. Gửi giày trước 14:00 chỉ để lấy hôm sau.

docs.title: E-mail · To: Lena Hartmann · From: Omar Nasser · Subject: Thursday's visit
docs.text:
Hi Lena,
Thanks for agreeing to show me around your factory on Thursday. My train arrives in Linden at 9:40 A.M., so I should be at your office by 10:15. Would it be possible to see the packaging line first? That's the part of the process my team is most interested in. Also, please let me know if I need to bring any safety equipment.
Best regards,
Omar

qs.q: Why did Mr. Nasser write the e-mail?
qs.a: To discuss plans for a visit
qs.ev: Thanks for agreeing to show me around your factory on Thursday.
qs.why: Anh bàn kế hoạch đến thăm nhà máy hôm thứ Năm.

qs.q: What does Mr. Nasser ask about?
qs.a: Whether he should bring safety gear
w: How long the tour will last
qs.ev: please let me know if I need to bring any safety equipment
qs.why: Anh hỏi có cần mang đồ bảo hộ không.

docs.title: Article · Dunmore Times
docs.text:
Dunmore Market Hall Reopens
After eighteen months of repairs, Dunmore's historic Market Hall reopened to the public on Saturday. The 120-year-old building now has a new roof, brighter lighting, and space for forty-two vendors, up from thirty before the work began. The city paid for most of the $3.2 million project, with the rest coming from local businesses.
Vendor Grace Okafor, who has sold cheese at the market for twenty years, said sales on opening day were the best she had ever seen. "We even ran out before noon," she said.
The Market Hall is open Tuesday through Sunday from 8:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
qs.a: The reopening of a historic building
qs.ev: Dunmore's historic Market Hall reopened to the public on Saturday
qs.why: Bài báo nói về việc Market Hall cổ mở cửa lại sau sửa chữa.

qs.q: How many vendors could the Market Hall hold before the repairs?
qs.ev: space for forty-two vendors, up from thirty before the work began
qs.why: Trước khi sửa có chỗ cho 30 gian hàng (thirty), nay 42.

qs.q: What is suggested about Ms. Okafor?
qs.a: Her products sold out quickly on opening day.
w: She helped pay for the repairs.
qs.ev: We even ran out before noon
qs.why: Bà bán hết hàng trước trưa ngày khai trương.

docs.title: Memo · To: All Employees · From: Building Services · Subject: New bicycle room
docs.text: We are pleased to announce that a secure bicycle storage room will open in the basement on May 6. [1] The room has space for sixty bicycles, as well as lockers and a small repair station with basic tools. [2] To use the room, employees must register their bicycle with Building Services and will then receive an access card. [3] Spaces will be assigned on a first-come, first-served basis. [4] Employees who cycle to work may also use the showers next to the gym on the ground floor.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
qs.ev: a secure bicycle storage room will open in the basement on May 6
qs.why: Thông báo mở phòng giữ xe đạp mới dưới tầng hầm.

qs.q: What must employees do to use the room?
qs.ev: employees must register their bicycle with Building Services
qs.why: Phải đăng ký xe với Building Services để nhận thẻ ra vào.

qs.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "This card will also open the side entrance next to the bicycle room."
qs.why: "This card" chỉ access card vừa nhắc ở câu đứng trước [3]; ở các vị trí khác chưa có / không còn nói tới thẻ.

docs.title: Web page · Alder Valley Hiking Club
docs.text:
About Us
The Alder Valley Hiking Club organizes guided walks every weekend from April to October. Our walks range from easy two-hour trails to full-day mountain hikes, and each one is led by an experienced volunteer guide. Membership costs $35 per year and includes a monthly newsletter and discounts at three local outdoor shops. Non-members are welcome to join up to two walks before deciding whether to become members. To reserve a place on a walk, simply sign up on the Events page at least two days in advance.

qs.q: What is indicated about the club's walks?
w: They are only for experienced hikers.
They all last a full day.
qs.ev: each one is led by an experienced volunteer guide
qs.why: Mỗi chuyến đều do hướng dẫn viên tình nguyện dẫn. Chỉ có từ tháng 4 tới tháng 10, có chuyến dễ 2 giờ.

qs.q: On the Web page, the word "range" is closest in meaning to
qs.ev: Our walks range from easy two-hour trails to full-day mountain hikes
qs.why: range from A to B = trải từ A đến B, tức là khác nhau (vary).

qs.q: How can people who are not members try the club?
qs.a: By joining up to two walks
qs.ev: Non-members are welcome to join up to two walks before deciding whether to become members.
qs.why: Người chưa là hội viên được đi tối đa 2 chuyến trước khi quyết định.

docs.title: Online chat
docs.text:
Kenji Abe (2:05 P.M.): Hi team, the client in Lisbon just moved our video call from Thursday to Wednesday at 9 A.M. our time.
Sara Lind (2:06 P.M.): That's earlier than planned. Are the slides ready?
Kenji Abe (2:07 P.M.): Mostly. We still need the updated sales figures.
Tom Price (2:09 P.M.): I'll have them by tomorrow noon.
Sara Lind (2:10 P.M.): That works. I can add them to the slides tomorrow afternoon.
Kenji Abe (2:11 P.M.): Great. Tom, can you also book Room 5 for the call?
Tom Price (2:12 P.M.): Consider it done.

qs.q: Why did Mr. Abe start the chat?
qs.ev: the client in Lisbon just moved our video call from Thursday to Wednesday
qs.why: Khách dời cuộc gọi video từ thứ Năm sang thứ Tư.

qs.q: What still needs to be added to the slides?
qs.ev: We still need the updated sales figures.
qs.why: Còn thiếu số liệu bán hàng cập nhật.

qs.q: Who will add information to the slides?
qs.ev: I can add them to the slides tomorrow afternoon.
qs.why: Sara Lind nhận đưa số liệu vào slide chiều mai.

qs.q: At 2:12 P.M., what does Mr. Price mean when he writes, "Consider it done"?
w: He has finished the sales report.
He thinks the call is unnecessary.
qs.ev: Tom, can you also book Room 5 for the call?
qs.why: "Consider it done" = cứ coi như xong, anh sẽ đặt phòng 5 như được nhờ.

docs.title: Article · Tri-County Business News
docs.text:
Swiftline Couriers Switches to Electric Vans
Swiftline Couriers, which delivers packages for more than 300 businesses in the Tri-County area, has replaced half of its delivery vans with electric models. [1] The company plans to replace the rest by the end of next year.
[2] Chief operating officer Hana Cole said the new vans cost more to buy but much less to run. "Our fuel bills have already dropped by forty percent," she said.
[3] Drivers have also welcomed the change. Many say the electric vans are quieter and easier to drive in heavy traffic. [4] Swiftline is now installing charging stations at its two depots so that all vans can be charged overnight.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
qs.a: A company's change to its vehicles
qs.ev: has replaced half of its delivery vans with electric models
qs.why: Công ty chuyển phát thay một nửa xe giao hàng bằng xe điện.

qs.q: According to Ms. Cole, what has happened to fuel costs?
w: They are now paid by drivers.
qs.ev: Our fuel bills have already dropped by forty percent
qs.why: Tiền nhiên liệu đã giảm 40%.

qs.q: In the article, the word "welcomed" is closest in meaning to
qs.ev: Drivers have also welcomed the change.
qs.why: welcome a change = đón nhận, hài lòng với thay đổi (appreciated). greeted là nghĩa "chào đón người".

qs.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Maintenance costs have fallen as well."
qs.why: "as well" nối với ý tiền nhiên liệu vừa giảm ở câu trước [3]; ở [1], [2] chưa nói tới chi phí, ở [4] câu trước nói về lái xe.

docs.title: Letter · Brookline Community Theater
docs.text:
Dear Ms. Varga,
Thank you for your generous donation of $500 to the Brookline Community Theater. Your support will help us replace the old seats in our main hall, a project we hope to complete before our winter season begins in December.
As a thank-you, we have enclosed two free tickets to our spring production, The River House. You will also receive our quarterly newsletter, and your name will be listed in the program for all of this year's shows.
If you have any questions, please call our office at 555-0148.
Sincerely,
Marco Bellini
Development Director

qs.q: Why was the letter written?
qs.a: To thank someone for a gift
qs.ev: Thank you for your generous donation of $500
qs.why: Thư cảm ơn khoản quyên góp 500 đô la.

qs.q: What will the donation be used for?
qs.ev: Your support will help us replace the old seats in our main hall
qs.why: Tiền dùng để thay ghế cũ trong khán phòng chính.

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned as something Ms. Varga will receive?
qs.why: Thư nhắc vé miễn phí, bản tin, tên in trong chương trình; không nhắc thẻ gửi xe.

qs.q: When does the theater's winter season begin?
qs.ev: before our winter season begins in December
qs.why: Mùa diễn mùa đông bắt đầu tháng 12.

docs.title: Web page · Bluefin Boat Tours — Private Charters
docs.text:
Sunset Cruise (2 hours): up to 20 guests, snacks and soft drinks — $600
Harbor Lunch Cruise (3 hours): up to 30 guests, buffet lunch — $1,100
Island Day Trip (6 hours): up to 30 guests, lunch and a guided walk on Kestrel Island — $2,400
All charters depart at 10:00 A.M., except the Sunset Cruise. A 50 percent deposit is required to confirm all bookings. Deposits are refunded if a cruise is canceled because of bad weather.

docs.title: E-mail · To: bookings@bluefintours.com · From: Rina Patel · Date: August 3
docs.text:
Hello,
I'm organizing an outing for our design team on Friday, September 12. There will be 26 of us, and we need to be back in the harbor by 3:00 P.M., because several people have flights that evening. We would prefer a cruise that includes a proper meal rather than just snacks. Could you confirm that a boat is available that day?
Thank you,
Rina Patel

qs.q: What is indicated about all charters?
qs.ev: A 50 percent deposit is required to confirm all bookings.
qs.why: Mọi chuyến đều phải đặt cọc 50%.

qs.q: Which charter will Ms. Patel most likely book?
qs.why: Đối chiếu: 26 người (Sunset tối đa 20), cần bữa ăn, phải về trước 15:00: Island Day Trip 10:00 + 6 giờ = 16:00 → Harbor Lunch Cruise (10:00 + 3 giờ = 13:00).
qs.ev: There will be 26 of us, and we need to be back in the harbor by 3:00 P.M.

qs.q: Why does Ms. Patel need to return by 3:00 P.M.?
qs.a: Some team members are traveling that evening.
w: The office closes early on Fridays.
qs.ev: several people have flights that evening
qs.why: Nhiều người có chuyến bay tối hôm đó.

qs.q: How much will Ms. Patel most likely pay as a deposit?
qs.why: Harbor Lunch Cruise $1,100; đặt cọc 50%: $1,100 × 0.5 = $550.
qs.ev: A 50 percent deposit is required to confirm all bookings.

qs.q: In the e-mail, the word "proper" is closest in meaning to
qs.ev: We would prefer a cruise that includes a proper meal rather than just snacks.
qs.why: a proper meal = một bữa ăn đầy đủ (complete), đối lại với chỉ đồ ăn vặt. polite là nghĩa "lịch sự".

docs.title: Advertisement · Orchard Hill Cooking Studio
docs.text:
Cooking Classes for Groups
Looking for a fun team-building activity? At Orchard Hill Cooking Studio, groups of 8 to 16 people cook a three-course meal together with one of our professional chefs, then sit down to enjoy it.
Choose a menu: Italian, Thai, or Mexican.
Price: $75 per person on weekdays, $90 per person on weekends.
All ingredients, aprons, and recipe cards are included. Groups of 12 or more receive a free bottle of olive oil for each participant.
Book at least three weeks ahead at orchardhillcooking.com.

docs.title: E-mail · To: events@orchardhillcooking.com · From: Daniel Osei · Date: April 2
docs.text:
Hello,
I'd like to book a class for my team on Saturday, April 26. There will be 10 of us. Several people on the team are vegetarian, so we'd like the Italian menu if it can be made without meat. Also, one of our colleagues uses a wheelchair. Is your studio accessible?
Best,
Daniel Osei

qs.q: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
qs.a: To promote cooking classes for groups
qs.ev: groups of 8 to 16 people cook a three-course meal together
qs.why: Quảng cáo lớp nấu ăn theo nhóm.

qs.q: How much will Mr. Osei's group most likely pay in total?
qs.why: Thứ Bảy là cuối tuần, 10 người: $90 × 10 = $900.
qs.ev: I'd like to book a class for my team on Saturday, April 26. There will be 10 of us.

qs.q: What is true about Mr. Osei's group?
qs.a: It will not receive free olive oil.
w: It is too large for the studio.
It must choose the Thai menu.
qs.why: Nhóm 10 người, dưới 12 nên không được tặng dầu ô liu. Đặt ngày 2/4 cho ngày 26/4 (hơn 3 tuần) nên không trễ.
qs.ev: Groups of 12 or more receive a free bottle of olive oil for each participant.

qs.q: What does Mr. Osei ask about?
qs.a: Whether the studio is accessible to a wheelchair user
w: Whether he can bring his own drinks
Whether the class can be held on a weekday
qs.ev: one of our colleagues uses a wheelchair. Is your studio accessible?
qs.why: Anh hỏi lớp có lối đi cho người dùng xe lăn không.

qs.q: What does Mr. Osei say about his team?
qs.a: Some members do not eat meat.
w: They work in the food industry.
They have taken a class before.
qs.ev: Several people on the team are vegetarian
qs.why: Nhiều người trong nhóm ăn chay.

docs.title: Notice · Ridgeview Community Garden
docs.text: Ridgeview Community Garden has 40 garden plots available for the coming season. Small plots (2 × 3 meters) cost $40 per year, and large plots (4 × 6 meters) cost $90 per year. Water and basic tools are provided. Plot holders are expected to spend at least two hours per month helping to maintain shared areas. Applications are accepted until March 15, and plots will be assigned by March 22.

docs.title: E-mail · To: Tasha Brennan · From: Ridgeview Community Garden · Date: March 23
docs.text:
Dear Ms. Brennan,
Thank you for your application. We are happy to tell you that you have been assigned plot 17, one of our large plots near the east gate. Please pay the annual fee by April 5 using the enclosed form. The garden opens for the season on April 12, and our first shared work day will take place that morning at 9:00. We hope to see you there!
Kind regards,
Ivan Petrov, Garden Coordinator

docs.title: Product information · AeroPure 300 Air Purifier
docs.text: The AeroPure 300 cleans the air in rooms of up to 40 square meters. Replace the filter every six months; replacement filters cost $25 and can be ordered at aeropure.com. Your purifier is covered by a two-year warranty against manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover damage caused by using filters made by other companies.

docs.title: E-mail · To: support@aeropure.com · From: Felix Andersen · Date: January 9
docs.text:
Hello,
I bought an AeroPure 300 in March of last year. For the past week, it has been making a loud rattling noise, and the fan sometimes stops completely. I have always used AeroPure filters, and I changed the filter in September. Could you tell me how to get the unit repaired?
Felix Andersen

docs.title: E-mail · To: Felix Andersen · From: AeroPure Customer Support · Date: January 10
docs.text:
Dear Mr. Andersen,
We're sorry to hear about the problem with your air purifier. Since your unit is still under warranty, we will replace it free of charge. Please send us a photo of the receipt so that we can confirm the purchase date. A prepaid shipping label for returning your old unit will be e-mailed to you once we receive the photo. Your new purifier should arrive within five business days after that.
Sincerely,
Monica Reyes, Customer Support

qs.q: What is indicated about the AeroPure 300?
qs.a: Its filter should be replaced twice a year.
w: It can clean a room of any size.
It comes with a lifetime warranty.
Its filters are sold only in stores.
qs.ev: Replace the filter every six months
qs.why: Thay bộ lọc mỗi 6 tháng = 2 lần một năm.

qs.q: What problem does Mr. Andersen report?
qs.a: His purifier is noisy and sometimes stops.
w: His filter was the wrong size.
qs.ev: it has been making a loud rattling noise, and the fan sometimes stops completely
qs.why: Máy kêu lạch cạch to và quạt có lúc dừng hẳn.

qs.q: Why is Mr. Andersen's purifier covered by the warranty?
qs.a: It was bought less than two years ago.
qs.why: Đối chiếu: mua tháng 3 năm ngoái, viết thư tháng 1 → chưa tới 2 năm (bảo hành 2 năm, thông tin sản phẩm).
qs.ev: I bought an AeroPure 300 in March of last year.

qs.q: What does Ms. Reyes ask Mr. Andersen to send?
qs.ev: Please send us a photo of the receipt
qs.why: Gửi ảnh hoá đơn để xác nhận ngày mua.

qs.q: In the first e-mail, the word "unit" is closest in meaning to
qs.ev: Could you tell me how to get the unit repaired?
qs.why: the unit ở đây chỉ chiếc máy lọc không khí (device).
